channel.title: Research on BMN Lab
channel.description: Recent content in Research on BMN Lab

item.title: Bundle Analytics (BUAN)
item.description: A computational framework for investigating the shapes and along-tract profiles of white matter pathways across populations.

item.title: BundleWarp: Streamline-Based Nonlinear Registration of White Matter Tracts
item.description: A streamline-specific nonlinear registration method that intelligently warps white matter bundles while preserving their topological structure, outperforming both linear and image-based registration approaches.

item.title: Neurodegenerative Diseases
item.description: Applying tractometry to characterize white matter degeneration in Alzheimer’s disease, mapping how amyloid, tau, and APOE pathology reshape fiber tract microstructure across large multi-site cohorts.

item.title: Data Harmonization
item.description: Integrating ComBat harmonization into the BUAN tractometry pipeline to correct for multi-site and multi-scanner variability in diffusion MRI, boosting statistical power for disease detection.
